policies.duplicate: One duplicate arm response per query; one logical request
policies.roi: One ROI arm response per query; one logical request

sequential_uncertain.action: Use ROI response iff duplicate probability in [.25,.75] and crop bytes differ; else duplicate
sequential_uncertain.calls: one duplicate for every query plus one ROI for every triggered query

matched_random.count: Same number as sequential_uncertain over the full120; never label dependent
matched_random.selection: Sort sha256(jev-routing-matched-random-v1|seed|source_id) ascending, then source_id; first K
matched_random.action: Use ROI for selected K and duplicate otherwise
matched_random.interpretation: Three descriptive matched random selections; not trained seeds or independent datasets

geometry_small.action: Use ROI iff original-normalized candidate area<=0.5 and crop bytes differ

protocol.group_routing: Compute routing and matched K once on all120; subgroups only evaluate that frozen route
protocol.input_budget: Logical successful model requests and observed usage of selected saved calls; no monetary estimate
protocol.collection_budget: The full240 table was collected; replay logical budgets do not undo actual calls/retries
protocol.freeze_gate: prepare reads only formal contract and fixed candidates; evaluate requires stage05 complete and identical frozen predictions
